name: Pangolinfo Amazon Data
tagline: Research Amazon products, markets, search trends, and IP risk with 19 live data tools
description: The official Pangolinfo Amazon Data MCP gives Cline real-time, structured commerce intelligence without browser automation or proxy maintenance. Its 19 read-only business tools cover Amazon product details, keyword search, reviews, sellers, Best Sellers, New Releases, categories and niche analysis; Amazon Rufus shopping recommendations; Google SERP, AI Overviews, Trends and Maps; and WIPO design-patent and related US litigation-risk research. A Pangolinfo API key is required.

install.notes: Create a Pangolinfo API key at https://tool.pangolinfo.com, replace <PANGOLINFO_API_KEY> during installation, and keep the key private. Product details and setup help: https://www.pangolinfo.com/amazon-data-mcp/
